'''Kōji Ishii''' (Japanese: '''石井康嗣''' ''Ishii Kōji'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ishii was born on July 1, 1960, in {{wp|Wakayama (city)|Wakayama}}, {{wp|Wakayama Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actor as an adult. He first voiced the minor role of a {{OBP|captain|EP095}} during the {{aniseries|OS}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}. He then voiced the antagonistic [[Colonel Hansen]] during {{aniseries|RS}}. Ishii is currently affiliated with the talent agency Vi-Vo.
